text:
robi: quick design sync : we keep getting questions from customers who land on Roles and miss that SSO is required org-wide. idea: add a subtle row-level affordance that surfaces when org SSO != role setting. thoughts?
sylvie: subtle affordance yes. maybe a dim lock icon that only appears when a role's SSO requirement differs from org default. that reduces noise for homogeneous orgs.
omar: Agree. Also propose an inline affordance be interactive: click opens a tiny flyout that explains why SSO matters for that role and links to 'Make exceptions' flow.
trevor: Accessibility: if the flyout appears on click it must also be reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space) and have a focusable close. aria-expanded + aria-controls for the trigger button.
robi: Microcopy idea for the flyout header: 'Why SSO matters for this role' and for the action CTA use 'Change SSO setting'. keep verbs clear.
sylvie: For mobile we should avoid adding another tap target in the row. alternative: long-press on role to reveal the SSO state or show it in the role details sheet.
omar: Another thought: when someone starts the invite flow, surface a warning if they attempt to invite a user to a role that requires SSO but the org SSO is off. message: 'This role will require the user to set up SSO on next login. Proceed?' with link to org settings.
trevor: Good call. That prevents accidental mismatches. Make the warning dismissible and log the action to audit with event tag=invite_sso_mismatch.
access-bot: audit note: event schema proposal posted at /docs/audit/events.md -> includes event_type, actor_id, resource_id, prev_value, new_value, ip_masked.
robi: On the roles grid header, proposal: add 'Activity' quicklink that opens a transient panel (not modal) showing last 5 access-related events and a 'View all' button. keeps people in context.
sylvie: Panel must not trap focus. Use an off-canvas region with skip-to-main semantics and ensure ESC closes it. show a tiny timestamp of last event.
omar: For CSV exports, compliance wants a column 'sso_required' boolean and 'sso_effective' which shows final effective state considering org override. please ensure backend can provide both.
trevor: I'll sync with infra to confirm schema. we need to avoid confusion between role.setting and effective_setting.
robi: Visual treatment: row-level icon should be 14px, semi-muted. use tooltip text: 'SSO required for this role (enabled by Alice on Apr 7)'. tooltip must be accessible via focus, not only hover.
sylvie: copy tweak: change global toggle label from 'Require SSO' to 'Require SSO for org members'  removes ambiguity about who is affected.
omar: Logging/Retention note: when the Activity panel is opened from a role it should pre-filter to action in [invite, role_assign, role_update]. also include an export button that respects permissions.
trevor: Keyboard shortcuts: propose 'g' then 'r' for Roles, 'g' then 'a' for Activity. Document in the keyboard help overlay. make sure shortcuts are discoverable via '?'.
access-bot: compliance reminder: only users with permission 'audit:read' can export raw IPs. others see masked ip column.
robi: Next steps: @trevor confirm audit event fields and export schema; @sylvie mock 3 variants (no-icon, icon-only, icon+label) in figma; @omar prototype invite warning flow and export a tiny JSON schema; I'll run a 15m review post lunch.
sylvie: will post figma links by 5pm PT.
omar: prototype + event schema by EOD.
trevor: checking schema with infra now, will report back this afternoon.
access-bot: prototype job queued: 1780012450 -> will attach when ready.
robi: thanks everyone :thumbsup: well iterate after the review.
